blackbutler: In Victorian England, young Ciel Phantomhive makes a deal with a demon to get revenge on the people who destroyed his family. The demon serves him as Sebastian, a flawless butler.
blackcat: Train, once a feared assassin known as Black Cat, leaves his old organisation behind and becomes a bounty hunter with a new set of friends.
blackclover: Asta and Yuno grew up together as orphans. Yuno has huge magical talent, Asta has none, yet both dream of becoming the Wizard King.
blacklagoon: Rokuro, a Japanese office worker, is kidnapped by mercenaries in Southeast Asia and ends up joining their crew of smugglers.
blackrockshooter: Mato tries to befriend her quiet classmate Yomi, while in another world a black-haired girl with a glowing blue eye fights fierce battles.
blacksummoner: Kelvin gave up his memories in exchange for strong powers when he was sent to another world, and starts his new life as a summoner with a goddess as his first follower.
blacktorch: Jirou, a teen trained as a ninja who can talk to animals, rescues an injured black cat that turns out to be a legendary demon.
bladedanceoftheelemental: Kamito, the only boy who can contract with spirits, enrols at an academy for spirit-wielding maidens and enters a tournament called the Blade Dance.
blastoftempest: Yoshino and Mahiro are pulled into a war between sorcerers. Mahiro wants revenge for his sister's murder, and a sorceress stranded on an island offers to help.
bleach: Ichigo, a teen who can see ghosts, receives the powers of a Soul Reaper and starts protecting people from evil spirits called Hollows.
blends: Maika takes a job at a café where every waitress plays a character type, and the manager casts the sweet, kind Maika as the sadist.
blood: Saya is a high school girl with no memories of her past. Handed a sword, she learns she's the only one who can stop blood-drinking monsters called Chiropterans.
bloodblockadebattlefront: After a portal to another world opens over New York, Leo joins a secret group of superhumans who keep the city's chaos in check.
bloomintoyou: Yuu has never felt anything when someone confesses to her, until the student council president, Touko, says she has fallen for her.
bluebox: Taiki, a first-year badminton player, has a crush on Chinatsu, the star of the girls' basketball team, and then she moves into his house.
blueexorcist: Rin learns he is the son of Satan and decides to become an exorcist to fight demons.
bluegiant: Dai, a boy from Sendai who fell in love with jazz, moves to Tokyo with his saxophone and forms a band, aiming to be the best jazz player in the world.
blueliteratureseries: An anthology adapting six classics of modern Japanese literature, including Dazai's No Longer Human and Natsume Soseki's Kokoro.
bluelock: Japan's football federation gathers 300 high school strikers in a facility called Blue Lock, where only one will survive to become the national team's striker.
blueperiod: Yatora, a popular student who coasts through life, discovers painting and sets his sights on Japan's most competitive art university.
bluespringride: Futaba starts high school pretending not to be cute so the other girls won't shun her, and runs into Kou, the boy she liked in middle school.
bna: Michiru suddenly turns into a tanuki and flees to Anima City, a city for beastmen, where she meets the wolf Shirou.
boardingschooljuliet: At a boarding school split between two rival nations, the leaders of the two dorms are secretly dating, and must hide it from everyone.
bobobobobobobo: Bo-bobo, a man with a blonde afro, fights an evil empire that shaves everyone bald, using his hair-based fighting style.
bocchi: Bocchi, an extremely shy girl, practised guitar for six hours a day for years. Now she finally joins a band and has to play in front of people.
